title: Women's Equestrian – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Horse Girl Zip Up Hoodie – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose
seo.description: A horse girl zip up hoodie: HORSE GIRL BROKE ON PURPOSE on the back around a horse at a barn door, plus an embroidered horseshoe with a heart on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This horse girl zip up hoodie is for the woman who is broke on purpose and has never once regretted a hay bill, zipped on for the barn, the feed store and the show ring.

A chestnut horse with a white blaze leans over a weathered barn door and chews a wisp of hay, in rust, cream, blush and sage with a worn print texture. HORSE GIRL runs above it and BROKE ON PURPOSE below in western slab capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: cream and peach on Black and Navy, brown and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small horseshoe with a heart inside is embroidered on the left chest, and the word BROKE is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest horseshoe and heart and left-cuff BROKE, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose zip hoodie fit?
The Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose horse girl zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this horse girl hoodie warm enough for cold barn mornings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold barn mornings, muddy paddocks and long drives to the show well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, HORSE GIRL above the art and BROKE ON PURPOSE below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small horseshoe with a heart inside sits on the left chest with no words, and BROKE is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The horseshoe and heart on the chest and the BROKE cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a horse girl, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the rider who spends every dollar on hay and lessons. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
